name: Spectrum wheel
summary: A disc of spectrum wedges with rays past the rim; jumps and walks on beats. A backdrop.
credit: After the Wheel in Felix Turner's Uberviz (https://uberviz.io). No code used; written fresh.
hint: Each wedge is a band of the spectrum; quiet bands go dark. A backdrop for other layers.

params.label: Spectrum
params.help: Each band: every band against its own recent best, so all of them move whatever the mix. In balance: the bands on one scale, so a bass-heavy track looks bass-heavy and quiet bands stay quiet.

params.label: Punch
params.help: How much a wedge lights when its band strikes (its attack): kicks low, hats high.

params.label: Curve
params.help: Brightness is the level to this power: higher darkens quiet bands.

params.label: Jump on beats
params.help: The chance, on each beat, that the wheel jumps to a new angle.
